title: #170 - Tyrion And Jon Snow'S Identity
content:
#170 - Tyrion And Jon Snow'S Identity

The identities of Tyrion and Jon Snow

First, let me give you the conclusion: Jon Snow is the illegitimate son of Lyanna Stark and Rhaegar Targaryen (note, not a legitimate child);

The little devil Tyrion Lannister is the third child of Joanna Lannister and Tywin Lannister (the claim that he is the son of the Mad King is untenable, I will analyze it carefully for everyone).

1: Jon Snow.

Jon Snow's background is very certain. After Lyanna and Rhaegar had an affair in 282, Lyanna became pregnant and gave birth to him. The only suspense is how these two people got together.

My personal guess is as follows:

In the Harrenhal Tournament in 281, Rhaegar won the championship and gave the crown of love and beauty to Lyanna, and the two began to fall in love.

A year later, in the spring of 282, Brandon Stark married Catelyn Tully, and the Wolf family went south to marry.

Somehow, Lyanna appeared in the riverlands (she was not in the wedding procession), and then the Mad King ordered two Kingsguards to kidnap her.

Why?

I mentioned earlier that Rhaegar wanted to contact the nobles to rebel because the Mad King tortured his wife, Rhaegar's mother, all day long.

Although the Mad King was confused, he had loyal ministers like Varys around him, and it was Varys who facilitated the move of taking Jaime as a Kingsguard.

The purpose of kidnapping Lyanna was to gain control of the hostages, because she was the eldest daughter of the Wolf Family and Robert's fiancée, which immediately controlled the three families of the Fish, Wolf, and Deer.

But Rhaegar was still righteous, secondly, he had taken a fancy to Lyanna, and thirdly, he wanted to rebel, so he chased her and took her back.

Who is Rhaegar? In addition to being skilled in martial arts, tall and handsome, he is also a very literary youth, who likes music and reading, and often goes to the ruins of Summer Hall to play the harp alone.

A female man like Lyanna simply couldn't resist such an artistic man. The two broke the window paper between them and had a shameless love affair in Dorne for a year.

Note: Dorne is the territory of Rhaegar's wife.

This is probably how Jon Snow came about. The details may be slightly different, but it's almost the same.

2: Tall and mighty Tyrion Lannister.

There have always been rumors that he is the illegitimate son of the Mad King. There are also rumors about his eye color, hair color, love of dragons, calling himself Heshan, being told by people around him that he is not Tywin's child, and even difficult labor.

But the reliability of these statements is the same as the WeChat screenshot saying that Tyrion was fucked by a dog.

Straight to the point, let's show the evidence.

Tyrion was born in 273, so no matter whose child he is, he must have fought with Joanna Lannister in 272.

During this year, Joanna spent most of her time in Casterly Rock, the westernmost city, and only went to King's Landing during the tournament held ten years after the Mad King took the throne.

What happened at this time?

When Tyrion's mother brought Jaime and Cersei to meet Aerys II, the Mad King said in public whether Joanna had ruined her strong and proud breasts by feeding the golden twins.

This greatly insulted Joanna, and Prime Minister Tywin even resigned the next day.

After that, Joanna returned to Casterly Rock, and Tywin continued to stay in King's Landing.

In other words, if Tyrion was of Targaryen blood, the Mad King must have acted in these short two or three days.

The Mad King met Joanna publicly only once, that is, the audience mentioned above, when the Kingsguard were all around, especially Barristan Selmy.

It is impossible for the Mad King to force himself under the eyes of everyone without any news, so this time is ruled out.

If Aerys II wanted to cuckold Tywin, he had to take the initiative to find Joanna.

Let's take a look at the layout of the Red Keep. The king lived in Maegor's Holdfast, and Joanna and her husband Tywin lived in the Tower of the Hand, and they slept in separate rooms.

Maegor's Holdfast and the Tower of the Hand were not connected. If the Mad King wanted to do something, he had to run out of Maegor's Holdfast first, then climb the high steps of the Tower of the Hand, and then go in to find Joanna.

The Tower of the Hand has a feature that there are high steps in front. Joffrey went to his "grandfather" because Tywin moved the meeting to the meeting room of the Tower of the Hand, and questioned Tywin why he had to climb the steps of the Tower of the Hand.

According to Joffrey's physique, he didn't want to climb the steps of the Tower of the Hand. The Mad King should have to climb up without panting, and then find Joanna without alarming all Tywin's servants, and then fight smoothly.

And to do this, he had to avoid the Kingsguard, because the white robes took turns to guard the king day and night.

Coincidentally, a well-known knight was with the Mad King at this time: Barristan.

Who is Gossipstan Selmy? There is no gossip in the entire Red Keep that he doesn't know.

Unlike Varys, Littlefinger, and Pycelle, Barristan uses his ears to collect intelligence, which shows how good he is at listening to gossip.

If the king disappeared for a while and sent the Kingsguard away, Barristan would definitely know, but he never said anything about it from beginning to end, so the Mad King secretly went to fight Joanna is really just a rumor.

As for the three dragons, if one of the dragons of the Dragon Queen is dead (the show gave this role to the Night King, who killed it with a javelin, but in fact the dragon should have been taken down by Euron), then there are only two living dragons.
